purpose: Compose a 30–60 second product promotion around one problem, up to three evidenced benefits, and one CTA.
whenToUse: A concise product introduction or promotion is requested
Enough verified product and brand material exists for five to eight scenes
whenNotToUse: The request is general video editing, film generation, or a human-presenter replacement
Critical product facts or asset rights are unresolved
requiredInputs: up to three features or benefits

layoutContract.continuity: Reuse verified brand tokens and stable safe areas while adapting layout to each product.

motionContract.entrance: Every scene has a readable static composition before finite entrance motion is added.
motionContract.determinism: All timelines are paused and finite; random, wall-clock, and infinite-repeat behavior is forbidden.
motionContract.transitions: Every scene boundary uses an explicit supported transition or documented crossfade fallback.

transitionOptions.use: Use when shared geometry supports directional continuity.

captionRules.copy: Keep screen text shorter than narration and use the transcript as the only caption source when narration exists.
captionRules.placement: Reserve a consistent safe caption lane that does not cover product evidence or CTA.

fallbacks.action: Omit social-proof.v1 and allocate its time to evidenced feature or UI scenes.
Use authorized external audio or narrationMode=none and retain concise on-screen copy.
Use supplied-assets and record the failure in the run report.

qaRules: Product name or core result appears within three seconds
Five to eight scenes use one primary goal each
Final output has one CTA and at most three core features
